{{tc|Commander}} |brain=no |anime=no |manga=Adventures |roundnum=PS277 |roundname=A Beastly Cold Reception }} '''Sird''' (Japanese: '''サキ''' ''Saque'') is one of [[The Three Beasts]] of [[Team Rocket]] in the {{MangaArc|FireRed & LeafGreen}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga. In the {{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}, she was revealed to be one of the [[Team Galactic]] Commanders. {{spoilers}} ==History== ==={{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}}=== Sird was first seen as a silhouette in the [[Hoenn]] region with {{adv|Giovanni}}, [[Carr]], and [[Orm]]. They recovered remains of the Blue and Red Orbs, which have been turned into a {{i|Ruby}} and {{i|Sapphire}}, after the battle between {{adv|Groudon}} and {{adv|Kyogre}}. ==={{MangaArc|FireRed & LeafGreen}}=== [[File:Sird Adventures.png|thumb|left|200px|Sird in the {{MangaArc|FireRed & LeafGreen}}]] In her first appearance, Sird worked with {{adv|Giovanni}} and the other Beasts on the [[Sevii Islands]] and fought and defeated [[Lorelei]] on [[Seven Island]]. Later, she fell from the [[Team Rocket airship]] after it was taken over by [[Carr]], but she survived. She later tried to catch {{p|Deoxys}} by disabling it with an energy beam launched from her [[Poké Ball]] (later on revealed to be {{p|Darkrai}} being unleashed), but was foiled when {{adv|Red}}, {{adv|Green}}, {{adv|Blue}}, {{adv|Yellow}}, and {{adv|Silver}} (along with {{adv|Mewtwo}}) used their bodies to block the beam from Deoxys, who escaped. However, to their surprise, the five [[Pokédex]] holders' bodies were turned to stone as a result. Having one of [[Lorelei]]'s ice cuffs pinned and rapidly expanding from her left leg before she attempted the capture, she fled after remarking that this new gain is nothing short of capturing Deoxys as she had intended. [[File:The Three Beasts.png|thumb|200px|The Three Beasts]] ==={{MangaArc|Emerald}}=== Later, after the climax of the battle against the evil [[Guile Hideout]], [[Archie]] reveals that Sird temporarily saved his and [[Maxie]]'s lives just as they were about to be killed while fleeing in an air-car, at the end of the {{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}}. The means that she did this are unknown. She offered him and Maxie the armor and sword that would later transform Archie into Guile Hideout, claimed they would give eternal life, but said that there was only one armor so they would have to fight to the death to see who would gain the armor, with Archie winning and killing Maxie in the end. Strangely enough, after she gave the armor to Archie, she quoted {{DL|Sinnoh myths|Veilstone's Myth}}, which similarly refers to a man with a sword. Also worth noting is in a flashback from Crystal, before Archie and the armor vanished, when she asked who was behind it Archie muttered out "{{tt|Team Gal...{{tt|*|VIZ Media}}/It was...{{tt|*|Chuang Yi}}|In the original Japanese release, he muttered ''gi...n...''}}", the first few syllables of [[Team Galactic]], foreshadowing Sird's connection to the team. ==={{MangaArc|HeartGold & SoulSilver}}=== Sird appeared in Carr's flashback in ''[[PS445|Dealing With A Koffing Fit]]'', where Carr refused to allow not even his colleagues or Giovanni to take his position. ==={{MangaArc|Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire}}=== In ''[[PS601|Beedrill Prepares]]'', Sird was seen in a flashback with Giovanni, Carr, and Orm, where they were being watched by [[Blaise]] while recovering the remains of the orbs. ==={{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}=== Sird reappeared to take part in the {{PAV|37|battle of the}} [[Spear Pillar]], following the defeat of [[Jupiter]], [[Mars]] and [[Saturn]], sporting a new Galactic-styled uniform. She still has problems with the injuries she suffered because of [[Lorelei]]. Sird reveals that she only helped [[Archie]] or worked with [[Team Rocket]] as an undercover mission for her boss [[Cyrus]], in order to investigate about Pokémon from outer space, namely {{p|Jirachi}} or {{p|Deoxys}}. To fulfill her agendas, she selected a {{tc|Team Galactic Grunt}} and released him from the Team Galactic hive mind, implanting her will on him instead to carry out plans autonomously. This Grunt became known as the [[Advanced level Grunt]], and inherited Sird's obsession with the Pokédex, which she developed after her first encounter with the [[Pokédex holder]]s. Following the petrification incident, she explains that Mewtwo chased her all the way back to Sinnoh out of revenge for the Trainers she petrified, and she barely managed to escape its pursuit. Following this explanation, [[Riley]] appears and engages her in battle. She easily avoided all of his attacks and was able to escape along with the other Commanders. ==={{MangaArc|Platinum}}=== Sird is revealed to have released Darkrai into the [[Distortion World]], having deemed herself as unable to control it. It is not known what happened to her following Team Galactic's defeat and disbandment. ==Pokémon== ===On hand=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Sird |pkmn=Persian |gender=female |type1=Normal |img=Sird Persian.png |epnum=PS277 |epname=A Beastly Cold Reception |desc={{p|Persian}} seems to be Sird's most preferred battling Pokémon. She was first seen in the [[Icefall Cave]] where she was introduced alongside her Trainer, just as [[Orm]] and [[Carr]]'s first revealed Pokémon were. The next time she was seen, she fought against [[Lorelei]] in ''[[PS280|Some Things Are Better Left Unown]]'' and was overwhelmed and beaten by the [[Elite Four]]'s well-trained Pokémon, causing Sird to resort to underhanded means to win. Persian's known moves are {{m|Slash}} and {{m|Thief}}, and her Ability is {{a|Limber}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Sird |pkmn=Starmie |type1=Water |type2=Psychic |img=Sird Starmie.png |epnum=PS280 |epname=Some Things Are Better Left Unown |desc={{p|Starmie}} is one of Sird's battlers and seems to be used mainly for minor aerial transport using its psychic levitation. Besides being used for old-fashioned battles, Sird also uses its Camouflage to sneak behind her opponents and take advantage of their vulnerability when their guard is down. Starmie's known moves are {{m|Camouflage}} and {{m|Hyper Beam}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Sird |pkmn=Banette |gender=female |type1=Ghost |img=Sird Banette.png |epnum=PS289 |epname=Surprised by Sneasel |desc={{p|Banette}} is another of Sird's strong battlers. While she debuted much later than Sird's two other Pokémon, she proved quite versatile and nimble when she single-handedly overpowered [[Silver's Gyarados]] and succeeded in capturing him. Banette's known moves are {{m|Shadow Ball}}, {{m|Snatch}}, and {{m|Double-Edge}}, and her Ability is {{a|Frisk}}.}} ===Released=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Sird |pkmn=Darkrai |type1=Dark |img=Sird Darkrai.png |epnum=PS414 |epname=Double Trouble with Dialga and Palkia IV |desc={{p|Darkrai}} was the unseen Pokémon used by Sird to battle {{adv|Mewtwo}}, which caused the petrification of Kanto [[Pokédex holder]]s and Silver. Due to it being "uncontrollable", she released it into the Distortion World where it was controlled by [[Charon]] to be used against his enemies. It first fought Palmer, whose {{p|Cresselia}} was hostile against it, but was put to sleep and defeated. Later, it fought several other Legendary Pokémon in a battle with {{p|Giratina}} and {{p|Heatran}}. After Charon's defeat, it left now that it had been freed from its mind control. Darkrai's known moves are {{m|Dark Pulse}}, {{m|Hypnosis}}, and {{m|Dark Void}}, and its Ability is {{a|Bad Dreams}}.}} ===Controlled=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Sird |pkmn=Unown (multiple) |type1=Psychic |img=Sird Unown.png |cap=Sird's Unown |epnum=PS280 |epname=Some Things Are Better Left Unown |desc=Sird was able to awaken all the forms of {{p|Unown}} by solving the mystery of the [[Tanoby Key]], despite the fact that no one was able to do so before. Sird had them surround Lorelei as a way to distract her in order for {{p|Starmie}} to attack during their first appearance. She later also had them monitor {{adv|Deoxys}}'s movements and guard [[Trainer Tower]] from intruders. None of Unown's moves are known and their Ability is {{a|Levitate}}.}} ==In the TCG== [[File:Rocket Admin.png|thumb|right|Rocket's Admin. artwork by [[Ken Sugimori]] for the {{Trading Card Game}}]] As stated on the official website, Sird is based on the {{tc|Executive|Team Rocket Admin}} from the [[Pokémon Trading Card Game|TCG]].http://web.archive.org/web/20130513220208/http://family.shogakukan.co.jp/kids/netkun/pokemon/official/gallery/big_img/gallery46.html (Japanese) The following is a list of cards named '''Rocket's Admin.''' {{cardlist/header|Rocket's Admin.|Trainer|char=yes}} {{cardlist/entry|cardname={{TCG ID|EX Team Rocket Returns|Rocket's Admin.|86}}|type=Trainer|type2=Supporter|enset=EX Team Rocket Returns|enrarity=Uncommon|ennum=86/109|jpset=Rocket Gang Strikes Back|jprarity=Uncommon|jpnum=079/085}} {{cardlist/footer|Trainer}} ==Trivia== *Sird has direct or indirect relation with all four main [[villainous team]]s from Generations {{Gen|I}} to {{Gen|IV}}. She was part of both [[Team Rocket]] and [[Team Galactic]], and she gave armor and a sword to both [[Archie]] and [[Maxie]], the leaders of [[Team Aqua]] and [[Team Magma]] respectively. *Sird and her teammates are based on various fictional monsters. In Sird's case, she is based on {{wp|Count Dracula|Dracula}}.{{fact}} ==Names== {| class="roundy" style="background: #666; border: 3px solid #c00" |- style="color:#fff;" ! Language ! Name !
